functions.name: LoadSource
functions.signature: LoadSource(Target, Shader Source, Filename, Entry Point, Shader Stage, Definitions, Extra Dxc Args)
functions.docs: Loads the shader source and converts the input descriptor to a format suitable for ShaderConductor. If 'Definitions' is null, the previously loaded definitions are not modified.

functions.name: RewriteHlsl
functions.docs:
Rewrites the specified HLSL shader source code. This allows to reduce the HLSL code by removing unused global resources for instance.
This will update the internally loaded source (see 'LoadSource'), so the output parameter 'OutSource' is optional.

functions.name: CompileHlslToDxil
functions.docs: Compiles the specified HLSL shader source code to DXIL.

functions.name: CompileHlslToSpirv
functions.docs: Compiles the specified HLSL shader source code to SPIR-V.

functions.name: RemoveLineDirectives
functions.docs: Replaces #line 123 directives with //ine 123. Required to work around platform-specific shader debug data handling issues.

functions.name: OptimizeSpirv
functions.signature: OptimizeSpirv(Target, Spirv, Opt Configs, Opt Config Count)
functions.docs: Performs the specified optimization passes (e.g. "-O" or "--strip-reflect") on the SPIR-V module.

functions.name: CompileSpirvToSource
functions.signature: CompileSpirvToSource(Target, Options, Target, In Spirv, In Spirv Byte Size, Out Source)
functions.docs: Compiles the specified SPIR-V shader binary code to high level source code (Metal or GLSL).

functions.name: CompileSpirvToSourceAnsi
functions.signature: CompileSpirvToSourceAnsi(Target, Options, Target, In Spirv, In Spirv Byte Size, Out Source)
functions.docs: Compiles the specified SPIR-V shader binary code to high level source code (Metal or GLSL) stored as null terminated ANSI string.

functions.name: CompileSpirvToSourceBuffer
functions.signature: CompileSpirvToSourceBuffer(Target, Options, Target, In Spirv, In Spirv Byte Size, Output Callback)
functions.docs: Compiles the specified SPIR-V shader binary code to high level source code (Metal or GLSL) stored as byte buffer (without null terminator as it comes from ShaderConductor).

functions.name: FlushErrors
functions.docs: Flushes the list of current compile errors and moves the ownership to the caller.

functions.name: GetSourceString
functions.docs: Returns a pointer to a null terminated ANSI string of the internal loaded sources, or null if no source has been loaded yet. This is automatically updated when RewriteHlsl() is called.

functions.name: GetSourceLength
functions.docs: Returns a length of the internal loaded sources (excluding the null terminator). This is automatically updated when RewriteHlsl() is called.

functions.name: GenerateDxcArguments
functions.docs: Returns the DXC command line arguments for the specified options. This does not include an output file, i.e. "-Fo" argument is not included.

functions.name: ConvertCompileErrors
functions.docs: Convert array of error string lines into array of <FShaderCompilerError>.

functions.name: IsIntermediateSpirvOutputVariable
functions.docs:
Returns whether the specified variable name denotes an intermediate output variable.
This is only true for a special identifiers generated by DXC to communicate patch constant data in the Hull Shader.

functions.name: GetIdentifierTable
functions.docs: Returns the table of special identifiers generated by ShaderConductor.

functions.name: Disassemble
functions.signature: Disassemble(Language, Binary, Binary Byte Size, Out Assembly Text)
functions.docs: Disassembles the specified SPIR-V or DXIL module and returns its assembly as text representation.

functions.name: Disassemble
functions.signature: Disassemble(Language, Binary, Binary Byte Size, Out Shader Stat)
functions.docs: Helper function to disassemble the specified SPIR-V or DXIL module and add it to the output code reflection array.

functions.name: GetShaderFileExt
functions.docs: Returns a filename extension for the specified shading language and shader stage, e.g. "frag" for a GLSL pixel shader.

functions.name: Shutdown
functions.docs: Explicitly shut down ShaderConductor and DXC shared libraries. Only used for Linux to prevent dangling mutex on exit.
